stories.title: U.S. Dept. of Veterans Affairs deputy secretary reacts to NSA classified network going down temporarily
stories.summary: Adding to a string of nationwide tech outages, officials have not tied the failures together or to a cyberattack, while VA leader says their systems are 'safer.'

stories.title: St. Louis police investigating dead body found Nov. 11 as a homicide
stories.summary: Officers had received a call for a shooting in the 5300 block of Grant and found a man lying on the ground with a gunshot wound to his leg.

stories.title: Person shot at Florissant apartment
stories.summary: The report came in around 12:25 p.m. that a person was picked up with a gunshot wound in a nearby Schnucks parking lot.

stories.title: Man receives 45 years in prison for 2016 shooting that left Ballwin police officer paralyzed
stories.summary: Antonio Taylor, 42, was sentenced to 45 years in the Missouri Department of Corrections in a plea agreement with prosecutors.

stories.title: Warren County parents voice safety concerns after Black Hawk Middle School stabbing
stories.summary: At a meeting closed to the media, families sought clearer emergency plans and more security as classes remained set to resume Tuesday.

stories.title: Stifel executive charged with DWI in fatal ATV crash
stories.summary: Michael Dressel was charged in a Dent County ATV crash that killed a High Ridge man on Oct. 31.

stories.title: Travelers grateful to get home as airports rebound from ground stop, United Airlines resolves outage
stories.summary: St. Louis Lambert International Airport logged no cancellations Monday, but a United outage emerged three days after the longest nationwide ground stop in 25 years.

stories.title: Road rage shooting at Florissant QuikTrip injures 1, police say
stories.summary: The Florissant Police Department said the shooting happened at 3:45 p.m. in the back parking lot of the QuikTrip located at 2105 N. Highway 67.

stories.title: Man killed in hit-and-run on Lucas and Hunt Road Saturday evening
stories.summary: The victim was identified as 28-year-old Kemario Newton of Northwoods.

stories.title: Here are the St. Louis natives who earned 2027 Grammy nominations
stories.summary: From Best New Artist to Best Comedy Album, St. Louis natives were nominated across several categories for the 69th Annual Grammy Awards.

stories.title: St. Louis police 'bait car' leads to arrest of 2 men
stories.summary: The men said they were going to scrap the vehicle for money, court documents said.

stories.title: Kirkwood native earns 4 Grammy nominations
stories.summary: The singer and songwriter earned four nominations, including three from her album "WOR$T GIRL IN AMERICA."
